### Summary of Completed Work

#### 1. Homonym Pair Curation & Promotion (`data/lexicon/homonym_pairs.yaml`)
- Created [`data/lexicon/homonym_pairs.yaml`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/homonym-paronym-promote/data/lexicon/homonym_pairs.yaml) with all **75 approved Miyklas homonym pairs**.
- Each entry adheres strictly to `schema_version: 1` and includes:
  - `slugA` and `slugB` matching the lemma slugs.
  - A natural Ukrainian distinction gloss (`distinction_gloss_uk`).
  - At least 2 natural sense-disambiguation sentence frames (`sentence_with_slot` with single `___` blank, `answer_form`, `confusable_form`, and `origin`).
  - Citations (`miyklas.com.ua`) and curator metadata (`miyklas-reviewed`).

#### 2. Paronym Pair Promotion (`data/lexicon/paronym_pairs.yaml`)
- Promoted all **48 remaining approved Miyklas paronym pairs** into [`data/lexicon/paronym_pairs.yaml`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/homonym-paronym-promote/data/lexicon/paronym_pairs.yaml), expanding the total count from 55 to **103 paronym pairs**.
- Verified all 103 pairs against `validate_paronym_pair` with 0 validation errors.

#### 3. Practice Deck Pipeline & SRS Integration

Added `_build_homonym_items`, `validate_homonym_pair`, `validate_homonym_item`, `read_homonym_pairs`, and CLI flag `--homonym-pairs`.
- **IO & Fingerprinting**: Updated [`scripts/practice_deck/io.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/homonym-paronym-promote/scripts/practice_deck/io.py) (bumped `PRACTICE_DECK_BUILDER_VERSION` from 15 to 16, added `homonym_pairs` to deterministic hash calculation, and allowed `practice-homonym.` shard prefixes).
- **Publisher**: Updated [`scripts/practice_deck/publish.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/homonym-paronym-promote/scripts/practice_deck/publish.py) to accept `--homonym-pairs` and include `"homonym"` in published asset definitions.
- **Audit & Asset Checking**: Updated [`scripts/audit/check_static_practice_assets.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/homonym-paronym-promote/scripts/audit/check_static_practice_assets.py) to validate `practice-homonym` shards.

- **Git Ignore**: Added `practice-antonym.*.json` and `practice-homonym.*.json` to `.gitignore`.
